messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.16.2 -> target group 'serving-eu' at 4% traffic. rollout_id=r-345678. change-window 2026-06-14T22:00Z-23:00Z.
tom: release notes posted? need the support blurb and changelog link.
release-bot: Release notes: https://release.redwood.com/3.16.2  highlights: fix for batching jitter, kv-cache restore safety, small decoder quantization tweak.
sara: i'll watch eu dashboards (errors, p95, kvcache miss).
diego: seeing a small cluster spike in eu-central-1: p95 embed latency 200ms -> 380ms at 22:03Z, sample 5xx ~0.6%. not uniform.
anya: can we scope a quick regional throttle instead of global abort? prefer partial pin if needed.
tom: product ok with 30m extension if we need it. ops prefers contain+pin approach.
sara: recommend drop region traffic to 1% and run focused smoke. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-345678 --region eu --percent 1`
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-345678: region eu target percent -> 1%... done. global remains at 4% elsewhere.
diego: re-check: errors dropped to 0.15% after throttle; one host still returning 502s on /v1/embeddings. stack: mem pressure during kvcache restore.
anya: plan: pin affected AZs in eu-central-1 back to v3.16.1 while we prepare a guard fix. command to pin AZs: `releasectl pin --region eu-central-1 --az az-2,az-5 --version v3.16.1`
tom: +1 from me. prefer AZ-level pin to minimize blast radius.
sara: doing pin now.
deploy-bot: releasectl: pin applied for eu-central-1 az-2,az-5 -> v3.16.1.
diego: smoke post-pin: errors gone on pinned AZs; overall eu p95 trending back to baseline.
anya: decision: keep eu at 1% for 20m, continue rollout in other regions. if eu 5xx > 0.5% for 10m we abort and expand pin to full region. log this for postmortem and add preflight check for kvcache config alignment.
tom: I'll patch the customer-facing note: "Partial pin in eu-central-1 to v3.16.1 due to transient cache warmup; global rollout proceeds at lower rate."
sara: noted and will monitor dashboards. thanks all. :thumbsup:
